planning: not measured
network: wired ≤ 1 ms; Wi-Fi pings up to 333 ms (MoveIt on the arm), so we run wired

div.div: Back up: get_angles (≤ 50 ms) → pose buffer → read() → joint_state_broadcaster → /joint_states at 30.0 Hz, intervals 28-39 ms (#33) → arm_controller checks tracking, MoveIt sees the result

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1318px; height: 1px; padding-top: 352px; margin-left: 2px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-style: italic; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Before the arm moves: one cycle to sample (≤ 34 ms) + a send (~20 ms) + firmware and servo start (~190 ms from write()). The Linux loop is a small part; the arm's own start dominates. Actions: move_action (MoveGroup), /arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory.
